en:
This is the hidden room...
It's much bigger than I expected.
This room's atmosphere...

Doesn't it remind you of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>
that admire Junko Enoshima...?

The mastermind behind this killing game
must be hiding in here.
Nyeeeh, where!? Where's the mastermind hiding!?
Here!
Huh?
Was that...Monokuma's voice just now?

Welcome to the final stage! Guess it's time
for the final boss to make their debut!
Wh-Where? Where's that voice coming from?
Wh-Where? Where's that voice coming from?
What is that!? A giant Monokuma head!?

F-For something like that to be able to talk...
It must've been enchanted by a powerful mage!
Wh-Where!? Where's the mastermind hiding!?

Please, Motherkuma! May we ask you 
where the mastermind is hiding!?
Why are you being so proper!?

Um, I can't share info that important. It would
make the killing game less exciting.

At least we know this is the mastermind's room.
It feels like a place for a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

There's no doubt this is the mastermind's room.
It's definitely for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

Oh, is it that obvious? Well, when you're
right, you're right.

The one you're all looking for comes to
this room quite often.
<CLT=cltMIND>Quite often?

But they're not stupid enough to let you
guys catch them in the act!
Wh-What did you say!?
Then, the mastermind isn't here?
<CLT=cltMIND>And if they come frequently, then—

Puhuhu, I think my <CLT=cltSTRONG>hint<CLT=typeNORMAL> just finally dawned
on Shuichi.
<CLT=cltMIND>Hint?

Why are you giving us "hints"?
Do you *want* us to find the truth?
What if I do?

As long as it makes the killing game more
entertaining, anything goes!
Even if that ends the killing game?
Hm? End the killing game?

Oh, you... Haven't I been saying it over
and over again this whole time?
The killing game is eternal!

It doesn't matter what you do, this killing
game will absolutely, positively never end.

The killing game is a symbol of despair!
How can something so fun just end!?
...What do you mean?

Oh, you don't need to fret over what it
means.
All meaning aside, it's the truth.

Puhuhu... The best thing you guys can do
is just accept that truth.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Clues to the Mastermind<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added
to the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
The mastermind isn't here!?

Share with us your divine wisdom, Motherkuma!
Where is the mastermind hiding!?

Nuh-uh. I won't tell you, no matter how many
times you ask. It would ruin the killing game.
Leave this to me!

Since you guys believe in me, 
I've gotta give it my all.

I'll find the clue, even if it uses up every 
last drop of my magic and kills me!

...I can hear the voice coming from
over there.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki glared toward the back
of the room.
There's something behind the curtain...

Is that... It's just a head, but is that
Monokuma?

This is definitely the mastermind's room.
It reeks of <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Even though Kokichi was a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>,
his lab didn't feel like this.

His lab felt like it belonged to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Supreme Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL>, and that's all.
That was Monokuma's voice just now, right?

Isn't Monokuma...outside, being held off 
by Keebo right now?

Could it be he activated another spare
since it was an emergency?
That extra Monokuma might...

...team up with the other one to make the last
battle cooler. Or that's how it usually goes.
What!? Really!?
...You seem almost happy, Himiko.
She said before that Monokuma was cute...

N-No...I mean...
Monokuma was our friend then...

But he betrayed us.
I won't trust him again.

There's no way we can believe in Monokuma...
He's our enemy, without a doubt.

And there's probably no doubt that 
the mastermind came here...

There should definitely be a clue.
Let's check thoroughly.

We're going to split up and check all 
the research labs again, right?

Since Keebo and the Exisals are destroying the
academy, who knows how much longer we have.

But we've got no choice but to do it!
Let's go!

You got this far, and you're gonna quit *now*?
You can't even look me in the eye, coward!

Puhuhu, scared? Well, can't say I blame you,
staring in the face of a final boss!
<CLT=cltMIND>There should be clues in this room!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can hear a voice from somewhere
in this room...

<CLT=cltMIND>What *is* that?
Monokuma...?
I suppose I should talk to it...

<CLT=cltMIND>We were finally able to get in, thanks
to Keebo destroying the hidden door.
<CLT=cltMIND>The only other way in was the card key...

<CLT=cltMIND>Of course, none of us have that, so
we couldn't get in before.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't look like there's a card
reader on the *inside* of the hidden door.

<CLT=cltMIND>I looked through the rubble thoroughly
but didn't find anything like that.

<CLT=cltMIND>Which means...you don't need a
card key to *leave* this room.
<CLT=cltMIND>In that case...

<CLT=cltMIND>Placing dust on that card reader wouldn't have
mattered if they came out from this side.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Hidden Door in the Library<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to
the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>To get in here from the library, you
normally would need a card key.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't look like there's a card
reader on the *inside* of the hidden door.

<CLT=cltMIND>Which means...you don't need a
card key to *leave* this room.

<CLT=cltMIND>Placing dust on that card reader wouldn't have
mattered if they came out from this side.
Are you...Monokuma!?
Of course. But I'm not just any Monokuma.

I'm the overseer of the killing game, and the
source of all Monokumas...

So I've been given a special name...
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Motherkuma<CLT=typeNORMAL>!
<CLT=cltMIND>"Mother"kuma?

So then...the machine that makes
spare Monokumas in this academy...
Oh, that's me.
You see this amazing machine behind me?

It creates spare Monokumas! All I gotta do
is copy over my thoughts and...
Presto! I give birth to myself!

Huh? A spare Monokuma? Can they be made that
easily? I thought they were advanced robots...
...Uh, yeah, that's why I'm so amazing.

No, that might be a lie. It's trying to 
trick us with fake information.

Anyone can see this thing is giving too much
information far too conveniently.

Huuuh? But it's not a lie.
I can make spares really easily.
Could you do that right now?
Yeah! Try and make a new Monokuma!
Huh? What's wrong?

I can't birth a Monokuma for someone
who doesn't love me.

What about after it's born, huh!? Did you
think about that? Take some responsibility!
Whatever, just give birth to a Monokuma!

No! I won't do it! I'm not gonna birth one for
someone I don't like just cuz they tell me to!
...Hurry up and give birth to a Monokuma.

...Are you listening?
We said to give birth to a new Monokuma.

It's totally ignoring us. I wonder if the thing
about the spares...was a lie after all.
<CLT=cltMIND>A lie, huh...
<CLT=cltMIND>But why lie about that?
<CLT=cltMIND>There has to be some motivation to lie...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Motherkuma<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

Hey, enough with this Monokuma.
Let's hurry and search this room.

You're right! The mastermind is hiding 
in here somewhere!

Shuichi, don't just stand around! 
Look for the mastermind!
Y-Yeah...

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right. First, we have to see
if the mastermind is hiding here.
<CLT=cltMIND>There should be other clues here as well.

B-Birth one!? Acknowledge the ones that are
yours before you make me birth another one!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder if what it said about
spares was really true...
The killing game will never end!

No matter what you do, this killing game
will never end! Never!

The killing game is a symbol of despair!
It's way to fun to ever end!

Puhuhu... That's the truth. All you can do
is accept it.

There's...something draped in fabric.
It looks suspicious...
<CLT=cltMIND>I cautiously lifted up the fabric, and...
A Monokuma head!?

Puhuhu... You found me. Or rather, you just
found a place that you were meant to find.
At any rate, you can't end the killing game.

The killing game was born from the womb
of despair...

Starting with the killing game at Hope's Peak
Academy created by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>...

They're all connected! The killing game is
despair itself!
<CLT=cltMIND>Wh-What is this!?

Uh-oh... It's not good to ignore the final
boss...

I was prepared to offer you half the world
if you joined me...but never mind!
Huh? Talk to me first.

Finally, it's my turn! I'm so excited to tell
you everything!
<CLT=cltMIND>This is a trash can.

I should investigate this, too.
I'm positive there's *some* clue here.
<CLT=cltMIND>I opened the trash can casually, and...
Ah?
<CLT=cltMIND>I let out a surprised gasp.
What is this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>This <CLT=cltSTRONG>thing<CLT=cltMIND> in the trash can
is much heavier than I thought...

A shot put ball!?
Why is this here?

<CLT=cltMIND>But there's no blood on this shot. It can't
be the one that Kaede used to kill Rantaro.

In that case...where did this come from?
Why is this here?
Ah, this is...

<CLT=cltMIND>I noticed <CLT=cltSTRONG>something<CLT=cltMIND> sticking
to the shot put ball.
Some cloth fibers from something...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Inspecting it closely, I can see several pink
fibers stuck to the surface of the shot.
They're pink...
<CLT=cltMIND>Wait! That means, this shot...
<CLT=cltMIND>...I understand.

<CLT=cltMIND>I know how to pin down the
mastermind of this killing game...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Shot Put Ball with Pink Fiber<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added
to the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
<CLT=cltMIND>There was a shot put ball in the trash can.

<CLT=cltMIND>But there's no blood on this shot. It can't
be the one that Kaede used to kill Rantaro.

<CLT=cltMIND>Inspecting it closely, I can see several pink
fibers stuck to the surface of the shot.
<CLT=cltMIND>That means, this shot...

<CLT=cltMIND>I understand. I know how to pin down
the mastermind of this killing game.

Uh-oh... It's not good to ignore the final
boss...

I was prepared to offer you half the world
if you joined me...but never mind!
Huh? Talk to me first.

Finally, it's my turn! I'm so excited to tell
you everything!
<CLT=cltMIND>A Monopad!? And there's blood on it...

Whose Monopad is this? And why is there
a bloodstain on it?

I don't know...
But we should inspect it closely.

<CLT=cltMIND>If this is a student handbook, the name of
the owner should show up when it turns on.
<CLT=cltMIND>I started up the Monopad, and...
This Monopad...is the Survivor Perk!?

<CLT=cltMIND>That means, in addition to the video,
Rantaro's Survivor Perk...
<CLT=cltMIND>was this <CLT=cltSTRONG>other Monopad<CLT=cltMIND>.
Is this a map of the Ultimate Academy?

<CLT=cltMIND>The places that open with the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>mysterious objects<CLT=cltMIND> are labeled, too.
<CLT=cltMIND>...As well as the hidden room.

<CLT=cltMIND>Which means this is a complete map
of the Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles.

So Rantaro was given this map as
part of his <CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor Perk<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

That's why he knew about the
hidden door.
Hm? What's this...?
A clue to end the killing game!?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The mastermind who is behind the killing game
is hiding somewhere within the academy.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Your best chance of exposing them is
when Monokuma needs a spare.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>At that time, the mastermind will
go to the library's hidden room.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>To prove this hint is accurate,
I will predict something.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The first thing you will remember
is the Ultimate Hunt.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Only share this information with people
who you know you can trust.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>How you determine that will mean your life
or your death.  —Rantaro Amami

<CLT=cltMIND>A hint to yourself from yourself...
That was part of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor Perk<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's why Rantaro brought it up.
Because he read this hint.

Hey, I have a question.
This might sound a little weird, but...

Does the term <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>
ring a bell for anyone?

This is exactly what Monokuma wants us to
do... So what else is part of his plan?

Is my memory part of it too?
If it is, then...
...can I even trust myself?

<CLT=cltMIND>Even he didn't completely believe it...
But he had no choice.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's why he went to the library.
That's what started all of this...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor's Perk Monopad<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

That Monopad isn't the student handbook.
It looks like something else...

But, is that a bloodstain?
Whose blood is this?
I was going to check that.

If I can determine whose blood this is, we'll
be that much closer to the truth.
How are you going to check...?

The camera Kaede and I set up here.
We can deduce it from the pictures.
That picture is in Kokichi's room.

That punk...gathered evidence from the
past cases, just so he could...
I bet he collected that picture, too.

So, which one do you need?
There were several pictures, right?

The last picture taken of Rantaro, the one
in which he was trying to remove the camera.

The one where the camera lured him with
the flash...

...Got it. I'll go retrieve it, so I'll let you
handle this area.

Maki...be careful, okay?
Keebo and the Exisals are fighting—
Hey, who do you think I am?
...Do you want to die?

...I've finally reached the point where I can
tell that that was a joke.
<CLT=cltMIND>This Monopad...

<CLT=cltMIND>This was the Monopad that Rantaro received
as a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor Perk<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor Perk Mononopad<CLT=cltMIND> contains
a map of the entire academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>Which means Rantaro knew about the
hidden room from the beginning.
And...

He had this hint to himself. A hint about
how to stop the killing game...
That was also part of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor Perk<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The mastermind who orchestrated the killings
is hiding somewhere within the academy.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You will need the spare Monokuma to
have any hope of catching them.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>At that time, the mastermind will
head to the room deep within the library.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>I predict that this clue
is proof of the truth.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The first thing you will remember
is the Ultimate Hunt.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Only share this information with people
who you know you can trust.
-Rantaro Amami

<CLT=cltMIND>That's why Rantaro brought it up.
Because he read this hint.

Hey, I have a question.
This might sound a little weird, but...

Does the term <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>
ring a bell for anyone?

This is exactly what Monokuma wants us to
do... So what else is part of his plan?

Is my memory part of it too?
If it is, then...
...can I even trust myself?

<CLT=cltMIND>Even he didn't completely believe it...
But he had no choice.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's why he went to the library.
That's what started all of this...

<CLT=cltMIND>This blood on the Monopad...
Whose blood is this?

<CLT=cltMIND>If we look at the picture taken of Rantaro's
final moments, we should be able to tell.
I'll leave the pictures to Maki.

<CLT=cltMIND>Alright...I've finished investigating
everything I needed to.

Nyeeeh!? What's going on?
I can't find the mastermind anywhere!
They weren't hiding here...
Did you find anything, Shuichi?

I've inspected everything I found, but I feel
like there's still something hidden here...
...Ah! Aaugh!!!

A-Again!
Another...memory!
...What?
Wh-What...?
This is...

Hiya, Shuichi! Looks like you've finally
woken up from a long sleep!
What?
M-Monokuma?

Although we're meeting for the first time,
you already know me...

Puhuhu... Well, of course you know.
I'm famous, after all.

Hope's Peak Academy's killing game was the
most watched event in televison history.

Why is Monokuma here?
I-It can't be...

Oh, but it can.
This is where it all begins.

A brand-new killing game, courtesy of
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
K-Killing game!?

Now then, from here things will proceed
how they usually do.

You'll all lose your memories and forget
everything that's happened up to this point.

The stakes of the Gofer Project, the hopes
and dreams that humanity entrusted to you...

Oh, and you'll forget that you're the last 16
survivors of the human race, too.

The bonds of trust you've forged, your
disgusting promises of friendship...

All that's gonna go bye-bye when the
killing game starts!

What...?
Wh-Why are you doing this...?

There's no point in asking me questions.
You're gonna forget everything, anyway.

Who's behind this!? Who *are* you!?
Junko Enoshima is dead—

Like I said, there's no point. You'll just
forget that, too.

Y-You're lying!
How could I ever forget this!?
Ta-da! The Blackout Light!
...What?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Blackout Light<CLT=typeNORMAL> has the power to induce
total <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory loss<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

The light it emits stimulates the basal
nuclei and the hippocampus—
W-Wait a minute!
Nope! I'm not gonna wait!

I'm gonna use this light, then I'm gonna shove
you all into lockers while you're unconscious...
And then the killing game will begin!
Ah!
<CLT=cltMIND>I...remember...
<CLT=cltMIND>my final lost memory.

Th-That was from...just after we woke up 
from cold sleep...

Yes...a memory from right before
the killing game began.

We were each woken up by Monokuma 
and our memories were taken...
A-And we were forced...to do all this...?

W-We were going to work together...
We promised to become friends...
Monokuma...I'll never forgive you!
Me too! I'll absolutely...never forgive him!

I feel the same way...
But right now, we need to investigate.
Dawn is coming.

Then...leave things here to me.
You go check the other places.
What?

You feel like there's still a mystery here, 
right, Shuichi? Then I'll find it for you.

We're all trying to work together and find 
the truth, but I haven't found any clues yet...
I need to recover my honor!
Himiko...will you be okay by yourself?
That's a stupid question!

Since I got that memory back, I'm now
overwhelmed with anger!

With my skills, I'll catch the dastardly 
Monokuma and the mastermind!

...I understand.
Then I'll leave it to you, Himiko.

What? W-Wait, really? Are you seriously going
to leave it to me? All by myself?

If you're not confident enough to do it, 
then you don't need to force yourself...
N-No, I'm okay!

Since you believe in me, I need to give 
it my all...

I'll find the clue, even if it uses up every 
last drop of my magic and kills me!
D-Don't say such unlucky things...

I'm just letting you know how determined I am.
You guys should believe in me and go on ahead.

Thank you. That really makes me
feel better, Himiko.

What should we do? With how little time 
is left, it's probably best to split up, right?

Yes. We need to split up and
check all the labs one more time.

If we missed a clue in any of them...
it would most likely be *that* one.
Got it! Let's go!
Be careful.
You too, Himiko.
